exclusion_reason: A code write invalidates and re-decodes exactly the affected instructions while untouched instructions are reused from the decode cache, bit-exact against the interpreter oracle, but the trigger is an explicit host writeCode rather than a guest store into its own page detected mid-run, so whole in-run self-modification through the recompiled memory surface is not yet closed.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when a guest store into its own executed page is detected mid-run, the affected block re-decodes to the freshly written behavior before its next execution, and untouched blocks never re-decode, across the fixture.
expected_failing_assertion: In-run detection of a guest store into a recompiled page is modelled through an explicit writeCode trigger rather than the recompiled memory-write surface, so a fixture that patches and immediately re-enters its own page within one run is not yet closed end to end.
active_gate_evidence: test/recompile.test.mjs drives createHybridRecompiler: the first compile decodes every instruction fresh; after a writeCode into the code page, exactly the modified instruction re-decodes (reDecodedInstruction is the single patched address) while every untouched instruction is reused (keptInstruction), and the rewritten behavior is bit-exact against the interpreter oracle over the modified image (register, memory_sha256, trace_sha256).
procedure: Run a fixture that rewrites an executed page after a declared trigger.
Assert the rewritten instruction takes effect on the next execution of the page.
Assert untouched block stay on the fast path without re-decode.
pass_criterion: Self-modified page re-decode before the next execution.
